question: When was the Azad Hind Government founded by Subhash Chandra Bose?
solution:
The correct answer is** __21 October 1943.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Temporary Administration of Free India, or Azad Hind,** was an Indian provisional government founded during World War II in Japanese-occupied Singapore.
 
• It was founded **in October 1943** and was heavily financed and dependent on the Empire of Japan.
 
• It was resurrected upon **Subhas Chandra Bose's arrival** in Southeast Asia in 1943.
 
• The army was declared to b**e Bose's Arzi Hukumat-e-Azad Hind's army (th**e Provisional Government of Free India)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose **was an Indian nationalist whose resistance of British rule in India .
 
• He earned a national hero title, his wartime alliances with** Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan** left an authoritarian, anti-Semitic, and militaristic legacy.
